platform_rule: AI Operational Readiness strengthens existing Platform A modules rather than introducing a separate governance framework.
platform_position: Platform A should evaluate organizational readiness for AI-enabled operations, not only the technical behavior of AI systems.
engineering_principle: Technology adoption alone does not constitute transformation. Transformation occurs when AI becomes an accountable operational capability supported by governance, evidence, and human oversight.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Have workflows been redesigned for AI-enabled operations rather than simply adding AI on top of old processes?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Evaluate whether process steps, controls, handoffs, decision points, and operating procedures have been redesigned for AI-assisted work.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Who owns decisions when AI contributes to the workflow?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Define accountable decision owners, reviewer roles, approver roles, escalation owners, and responsibility boundaries.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Are human and AI responsibilities clearly separated?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Map what AI may recommend, prepare, summarize, execute, or block, and what humans must review, approve, own, or escalate.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Is there a recurring governance rhythm for AI-enabled operations?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Evaluate review cadence, risk review, control review, incident review, outcome review, evidence review, and change review.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Are approval pathways defined for AI-assisted decisions and actions?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Determine when human approval is required, who approves, what evidence must be reviewed, and what approval state blocks execution.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Can uncertain, high-risk, failed, or disputed AI-assisted outcomes be escalated?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Define escalation rules, issue owners, exception paths, risk acceptance, remediation, and stop-use conditions.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Are controls in place to govern AI-enabled operations at runtime?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Evaluate runtime controls, access boundaries, tool governance, monitoring, blocked actions, policy checks, and control evidence.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Can AI-enabled operations be replayed with evidence?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Bind workflow intent, context, AI recommendation, human review, approval, action, state verification, and outcome into evidence packages.

assessment_dimensions.engineering_question: Is the organization measuring whether AI-enabled operations improve outcomes safely and effectively?
assessment_dimensions.assurance_role: Evaluate operational outcomes, risk outcomes, quality outcomes, exception trends, user feedback, control effectiveness, and improvement actions.

maturity_model.description: No meaningful AI use in operational workflows.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Document current process baseline and identify where AI use is not yet approved.

maturity_model.description: AI is being explored informally or in controlled experiments.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Define experiment boundaries, data-use limits, human review, and non-operational-use rules.

maturity_model.description: AI pilots are running in limited workflows with defined scope.
maturity_model.operating_model_state: Pilot workflows with limited operational exposure.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Define pilot owner, success criteria, risk controls, approval rules, and evidence collection.

maturity_model.description: AI is deployed in operational workflows, but the operating model may not be fully redesigned.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Define decision ownership, workflow controls, monitoring, escalation paths, and evidence packages.

maturity_model.description: AI is embedded into redesigned workflows with defined approvals, controls, roles, and evidence.
maturity_model.operating_model_state: Operational workflows redesigned around AI-assisted work.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Establish governance cadence, approval pathways, responsibility maps, runtime controls, and outcome measurement.

maturity_model.level_name: AI-enabled Operating Model with Assurance Engineering Controls
maturity_model.description: AI operates as an accountable capability supported by governance, evidence, human oversight, operational controls, and continuous assurance.
maturity_model.operating_model_state: AI-enabled operating model with Assurance Engineering.
maturity_model.minimum_expectation: Maintain continuous operational assurance, evidence replay, outcome review, human oversight, and improvement cadence.

sample_readiness_assessment.summary: AI has been deployed, but workflow redesign, governance cadence, escalation paths, runtime controls, and outcome measurement are incomplete.
strengths: Human review exists for selected workflows
required_actions: Redesign workflows around accountable AI-enabled operations.
Define decision ownership and human-AI responsibility matrix.
Formalize governance cadence and approval pathways.
Implement runtime controls, escalation paths, and evidence packages.
Measure operational outcomes and control effectiveness.
